EXCERPT / LOCATOR
Revenue grew 26%… Product revenue grew 52%… Billings grew 33%.
INTERPRETATION

Current network/firewall demand is real; strongest realized network-security acceleration in the panel.

LIMITATIONS / CONFOUNDS

Refresh, pricing, and share shift may explain part of the result independently of AI infrastructure.

CONFLICTING EVIDENCE
Check Point — Check Point Q2 2026 Results

Near-flat total revenue. Blocks a uniform network-security acceleration call.

Cisco — Cisco Security Q4 and FY2026 Results

Quarterly momentum improved; full-year security breadth remained weak.

IANS Research — IANS Security Budget Benchmark (2023–2025)

No simultaneous broad security-budget acceleration; security lost share of IT as AI and cloud IT spending rebounded.

SEC-MARKET-SIG-BL-002 — Lag Hypothesis Disposition — Episode 002 Baseline

The evidence supports a descriptive sequence, not a constant infrastructure-to-security lag.
